securityPreserved: API bind remains 127.0.0.1 unless the operator already changed it
notes: Default upstream --max-old-space-size=4096 is actively harmful on this 16 GB host because WSL already holds 12 GB.
Do not disable site isolation to fake fewer processes.
Affinity pinning is optional and off by default; WSL already owns 6 of 8 host threads.
